question: To which right-side endpoint may the dividing line extend, O twice-born?
premises: The line proceeds from the previously indicated thread or axis.
The direction specified is on the right side.
An endpoint is given between the heels of the left foot.
inference: The prescribed dividing line may extend on the right to the space between the left foot’s heels.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical sense of vāmapādapārṣṇyantaraṃ is somewhat ambiguous.
plain_english: O twice-born, from that line it may extend on the right to the space between the heels of the left foot.
